- Event handlers registered dynamically (wildcard dispatch pattern)

- No useState for app state

7. **Feedback App** - Bug reports and feature ideas

3. Design Name Uniqueness - Siblings must have unique names
4. Piece Name Uniqueness - Within design
5. Quality Name Uniqueness - Globally unique
6. Port Name Uniqueness - Globally unique
7. File Name Uniqueness - Globally unique

9. Connector Name Uniqueness - Within type
10. Model Name Uniqueness - Within type
11. Layer Path Uniqueness - Within design

- Sketchpad UI - In-app validation panel
- CLI - Command-line validation
- Backend - API validation endpoint

- `Camera` - Position, forward, up vectors

- Type contains: Models, Connectors
- Design contains: Pieces, Connections, Layers, Groups, Stats
- Piece contains: Connections (via connection endpoints)
- Connection has: Connected side (parent piece+connector) and Connecting side (child piece+connector)

- **3D Rendering**: `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`, `three`
- **Diagrams**: `@xyflow/react` (React Flow for node/edge graphs)
- **Force Physics**: `d3-force` with `dagre` for layout algorithms
- **UI Primitives**: Radix UI (accordion, avatar, collapsible, dialog, dropdown, hover-card, popover, scroll-area, select, slider, tabs, toggle, tooltip)

- **Styling**: CVA (class-variance-authority), clsx, tailwind-merge

**Key Components & Features:**
- `cn()` - Tailwind class merging utility
- `Expertise` enum - BEGINNER, NORMAL, EXPERT levels
- `setExpertiseProvider()` - Contextual expertise level
- i18n bundles for multilingual UI

- `elements/` - Element component stories

### 10. **[compose/graphql/schema.graphql](compose/graphql/schema.graphql)** - Complete GraphQL Design Data Model

**Query Types:**
- `node(id: ID!)` - Generic node query
- `kit(uri: String!)` - Query kits by URI

**Main Entity Types (GraphQL):**

**Kit** - Container for all design artifacts
- Properties: uri, name, description, icon, image, preview, version, remote, homepage, license, created, updated
- Collections: types, designs, attributes, concepts

**Type** - Component/kit definition
- Properties: name, description, icon, image, variant, stock, virtual, unit
- Collections: models, connectors, authors, attributes
- Geometry: location, concepts

**Design** - Assembly/scene definition
- Properties: name, description, icon, image, variant, view, unit
- Collections: pieces, connections, authors, attributes
- Geometry: location, concepts

**Piece** - Instance of a Type in a Design
- Properties: description, id_
- References: type (Type reference)
- Geometry: plane (3D placement), center (2D diagram position)

**Connector** - Connection point on a Type
- Properties: description, mandatory, port, t (ring parameter [0,1))
- Geometry: point (3D position), direction (3D normal)
- References: type, connections

**Connection** - Link between two Pieces
- Properties: description, gap, shift, rise, rotation, turn, tilt, x, y
- References: connected side, connecting side
- Geometry: transformation parameters

**Model** - 3D geometry for a Type
- Properties: url, description
- Tags: tag array for selection/filtering
- References: type

**Port** - Interface definition for compatibility
- Properties: name, description

**Quality** - Measurable property
- Properties: name, unit, min, max, defaultValue, formula

**Author** - Attribution data
- Properties: name, email, rank

**Attribute** - Key/value metadata
- Properties: name, value, unit, definition

**Geometry Types:**
- `Point { x, y, z }` - 3D coordinates
- `Vector { x, y, z }` - 3D direction
- `Coord { x, y }` - 2D diagram coordinates
- `Plane { origin, xAxis, yAxis }` - 3D spatial frame
- `Location { longitude, latitude }` - Geography

**Key Relationships:**
- Kit 1 → many Types, Designs
- Type 1 → many Models, Connectors
- Design 1 → many Pieces, Connections
- Piece → Type (reference)
- Connection → Connectors (via sided references)

## 📊 ARCHITECTURE SUMMARY

### **Technology Stack:**
- **3D Rendering**: Three.js + React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei)
- **Diagrams**: React Flow (@xyflow/react) with D3-Force physics
- **State Management**: XState (UI), Y.js (collaborative data)
- **Components**: Radix UI primitives
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4
- **Testing**: Vitest + Playwright
- **GraphQL**: Schema-driven design model
- **Persistence**: IndexedDB (browser), SQL.js (embedded), optional backend

### **Key UI Concepts:**
1. **Sketchpad** - Multi-app unified environment (Home, Kit, Type, Design, Quality, Docs, Feedback)
2. **Windows** - Persistent containers (Table, Scene/3D, Diagram, Custom)
3. **Panels** - Toggleable sidebars (Details, Chat, Settings, Tools, Toolbar)
4. **Tools** - Interaction modes per app
5. **Canvas** - Main rendering surface (combines 2D diagrams + 3D scenes)

### **Key 3D Components:**
- `Canvas` - React Three Fiber root
- `Geometry` - Renders with selection/hover colors
- `Grid` - Reference plane
- `OrbitControls` - 3D camera control
- `GizmoHelper` - Transform gizmos
- Models load from glTF/3D formats

### **Design Model (GraphQL):**
- **Kit** → Types (components), Designs (assemblies)
- **Type** → Models (3D files), Connectors (ports)
- **Design** → Pieces (type instances), Connections (relationships)
- **Geometry** → Points (3D), Vectors (directions), Planes (frames), Coords (diagram 2D)
